thread:
lauren.marketing: Quick plan — we're doing pre-recorded product demos + 20m live Q&A. Want the replay gated for 30 days behind a simple form so we can capture new leads, then open after 30d. Need Ops to confirm recording delivery + captions.

ben_growth: Gated replay makes sense for mid-funnel. Suggest two flows: immediate registrants -> no gate; new viewers from ads -> gated. We'll use a query param `source=ad` to trigger gate on the replay landing page.

ops_jordan: Ops notes: set Zoom to record separate tracks (speaker, shared screen). Auto-transcribe audio -> SRT. After meeting end, ingestion lambda should move files to S3 `marketing/replays/2026/03/gated-launch/` and kick off transcode + captioning job. ETA for pipeline: 24hrs after dry-run.

editor_ash: Good to know. I'll need raw .mp4 + SRT + timestamps so we can produce 3 short clips (60s, 3m, 6m) for social and ad creatives. Please ensure we keep the highest quality recording.

lauren.marketing: UX for gate: show headline, 3 bullet benefits, email + company fields, minimal friction. Add a checkbox for content preferences. After submit, show instant playback token that expires in 30 days. Also add a hidden `campaign_id` field for ad attribution.

marketing-bot: Reminder: add utm_medium, utm_source, utm_campaign to all CTA links. Tag the HubSpot form `form_id: replay_gated_launch_0326`.

ben_growth: Lead scoring: assign +10 for live attendance, +5 for gated replay view >50%, +20 if they click demo CTA in nurture. Feed these back to HubSpot and mark MQL threshold at 30.

ops_jordan: For calendar invites, we won't do timezone dropdown this time (single live slot). Use ICS generator with UTC start and include local auto-conversion copy on page.

lauren.marketing: Reminder cadence: registrants get confirmation + calendar, 24h reminder, 1h reminder. Gated viewers get a "watch again" reminder at 7 days. Also send a clips email at 24h.

editor_ash: For clip edits, create Asana task `Webinar Replay - edits` and assign to me. Use tag `needs-closed-captions` so we can burn captions into clips for social.

ops_jordan: Fallbacks: if auto-transcript not ready within 3hrs, publish replay as "captions processing" and release audio-only transcript first. If ingestion lambda fails, we have manual S3 upload procedure documented in Confluence.

zoom-bot: Zoom webinar scheduled by ops_jordan  https://zoom.us/webinar/9876543210 (ID: 987-654-3210). Cloud recording: enabled, separate audio tracks: enabled, auto-transcript: enabled.

marketing-bot: Also add GA conversion goal `replay_gated_submit` and event `replay_watch_pct` to track 25/50/75/100%.

ben_growth: Ads targeting: retarget registrants who didn't attend within 3 days and show them the 60s highlight. We'll A/B creative: product benefit vs. customer story.

lauren.marketing: Owners: lauren.marketing (strategy + creative), ops_jordan (zoom + ingestion), editor_ash (edits + clips), ben_growth (ads + scoring). Kickoff dry-run tomorrow 9am PT. Anyone blocked?

editor_ash: Need PASS for S3 access and the sample raw file for codec tests.

ops_jordan: Granting S3 read/write to `editor_ash` now. I'll upload sample recording after dry-run.

lauren.marketing: Perfect. I'll drop the replay page wireframe in Figma and share link here when ready. Next sync 9am PT tomorrow. :sparkles:
